verses.text: But Jonah was very upset about this, and he became angry.

He prayed to the LORD, "LORD, isn't this what I said when I was still at home? That is why I ran off to Tarshish. I knew that you are a kind and merciful God. You are slow to become angry and full of faithful love. You are ready to change your mind and not bring disaster.
So now, LORD, please take my life from me. It is better for me to die than to live."
But the LORD asked, "Is it right for you to be angry?"
Jonah went out and sat down east of the city. There he made himself a shelter and sat in its shade, waiting to see what would happen to the city.
Then the LORD God made a leafy plant grow up over Jonah to give shade for his head and ease his discomfort. Jonah was very happy about the plant.
But at dawn the next day, God sent a worm, which chewed the plant so that it dried up.
When the sun rose, God sent a scorching east wind. The sun beat down on Jonah's head until he grew faint. He wanted to die, and he said, "It is better for me to die than to live."
But God said to Jonah, "Is it right for you to be angry about the plant?" Jonah said, "It is. I am so angry I wish I were dead."
The LORD said, "You care about this plant, even though you did not work for it or make it grow. It sprang up overnight and died overnight.
And should I not care about the great city of Nineveh? It has more than one hundred twenty thousand people who cannot tell their right hand from their left, and many animals too."
